paragraphs: Bulgarian Cavaliers excel in many melee fights, using faster attacks to overwhelm their opponents.
Polish Cavaliers trade armor for a much lower gold cost, bringing larger armies and a few standout melee wins.
Burmese Cavaliers are anti-archer specialists, with occasional standout wins such as their victory against Chu Ko Nu.
Sicilian Cavaliers shine against ranged armies and cavalry counters, combining strong armor with reduced incoming bonus damage.
